excluded_trials.reason: Collector failed before any native AUTO mode; retained source hashes.
excluded_trials.collector_error: TypeError("dict() got multiple values for keyword argument 'host_monotonic_ns'")

excluded_trials.reason: No raw camera stream; diagnostic preflight retained in source hashes.

frozen_lag.objective: First AUTO trial only; modes2/3; 0.3<=|firmware omega|<=20; residual centered per lag, largest5% removed.
frozen_lag.convention: Compare camera at source t to encoder at mapped host t+lag. A negative lag means camera corresponds to earlier encoder data.
frozen_lag.limitation: Descriptive timing alignment, not exposure-latency calibration. Support range is not a confidence interval.

methodology.encoder: Direct STATE.theta; reconstructed counts=(saved reference+theta*4096/(2π)) mod4096; current firmware ENC_INVERT=0. INFO.encoder_raw is reported separately. encoder_raw_age_us means time since raw count last changed, not acquisition freshness; it is never a freshness filter.
methodology.camera: atan2(bob.x-pivot.x,pivot.y-bob.y), raw marker geometry relative to image vertical. No calibrated/fused theta or mirrored encoder packets.
methodology.filters: Unique increasing source frames; detected measured track, stale=False, no worker error; confidence>=0.8; source age, host-source and collector receipt minus clock-mapped source<=150ms; length>5px and within20% of per-trial accepted median.
methodology.gaps: No encoder interpolation across >30ms; rejected camera tracks break segments; camera edges>75ms break camera holds/plots. No out-of-range extrapolation.
methodology.lag: Fit first chronological native AUTO trial only, never full HOME; frozen for later runs. Per-trial board lower-envelope and recorded camera clock anchors remain distinct from fitted lag.
methodology.rest_quality: Independently qualify >=100 disabled healthy states across>=4.5s with raw angle span<=0.03rad, max|omega|<=0.15 and step span<=3mm. Camera coverage requires>=30validframes, >=80%valid and >=75%windowspan; sparse measurements remain reported but unqualified.
methodology.thresholds: Strict: |angle|<=0.15rad, |rate|<=0.5rad/s, |step cart|<=0.05m, |step velocity|<=0.05m/s. Near-upright comparison: |encoder angle|<=0.25rad and |encoder rate|<=0.5rad/s.
methodology.limitations: No independent metric cart motion or gravity-vertical measurement; finite samples and latency/geometry errors can mimic sensor disagreement. No new calibration or hardware acceptance.

clock.limitation: Host receipt lower envelope is not independently measured board-to-host synchronization.

initial_rest.native_info_timing_semantics: encoder_raw_age_us is time since raw COUNT last changed, not I2C acquisition age. Repeated INFO readbacks are not proof of independent sensor acquisitions.

before_auto_rest.reason: No explicit start/end phase markers; no rest inferred from arbitrary idle states.

after_auto_rest.reason: No explicit start/end phase markers; no rest inferred from arbitrary idle states.

trials.interpretation: Native BAL mode is controller state, not physical balance. Strict thresholds are observed angle/rate plus step-estimated cart position/velocity. Image vertical is not independently measured gravity vertical. Direction/state groups are confounded by pose, speed, load and camera geometry; no causal slip/hysteresis conclusion.
